propositions: Dependabot PR #125 proposes two dependency bumps (zizmor 1.28.0→1.29.0 and mcp 1.29.0→2.0.0) but only the zizmor bump is safe to land; mcp 2.0 removes mcp.server.fastmcp module imported by multiple source files
The mcp 2.0 migration is blocking structural work already tracked separately in ticket 732b-51df-acf2-477b and was previously rejected in ticket 1dfd on evidence of missing v1 import paths
The zizmor bump must be landed by manually applying PR #125's safe subset to a fresh worktree, regenerating uv.lock with exact pinning semantics, and landing via Gerrit rather than GitHub merge

The exact pin 'zizmor==1.29.0' in the dev group must be regenerated via 'uv lock --upgrade-package zizmor' (not hand-edited) and must pass 'uv lock --check', 'make lint', and CI gating to preserve lock fidelity
PR #125 must be closed with a comment naming the merged commit and deferring the mcp 2.0 half to ticket 732b to maintain consistency and avoid duplicate re-litigation
